findings_addressed.oracle: Two independent assertions: (1) result is False, (2) _relaunch_elevated was never called. The relaunch-called spy list is empty iff the already-elevated guard short-circuited before reaching the UAC transport boundary. Both assertions are required; the second is the falsifiability gate.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/core/elevation.py delete the block 'if is_elevated(): _logger.debug("already_elevated"); return False' (lines 234-236). Without that guard, maybe_elevate falls through to _relaunch_elevated; the spy records the call and 'assert relaunch_called == []' fails immediately, turning the test red.
anti_patterns_eliminated: N7 (accepts-both-outcomes): previously asserted only 'result is False', which is also the outcome when _relaunch_elevated runs and ShellExecuteW fails; now also asserts the relaunch spy was never triggered, distinguishing the short-circuit path from the fall-through path

notes: G0113 (second pass): The prior hardening was accepted by the tool but rejected by adversarial review. Root cause: the test asserted only 'result is False', which is satisfied by BOTH the correct short-circuit path AND the fall-through path where _relaunch_elevated calls ShellExecuteW which fails and also returns False. Fixed by additionally monkeypatching elevation._relaunch_elevated (the UAC external transport boundary) with a spy that records calls. The combined assertion 'result is False AND relaunch_called == []' is only satisfied by the short-circuit path. Deleting the is_elevated guard causes relaunch_called to be non-empty and the test to fail. POST-WORKFLOW FIX (2026-06-22): adversarial reviewer flagged test_maybe_elevate_already_attempted_never_relaunches and test_maybe_elevate_disabled_never_relaunches as non-falsifiable: neither monkeypatched is_elevated nor _relaunch_elevated, so deleting the guard branch under test still returned False (via the is_elevated fallback when elevated, or via _relaunch_elevated returning False in a non-admin sandbox). Rewrote both to monkeypatch is_elevated->False (so the fallback cannot mask the bug) AND spy on _relaunch_elevated, asserting relaunch_called==[] - mirroring the already-falsifiable test_maybe_elevate_when_already_elevated_returns_false. Now deleting the disabled/already_attempted guard deterministically reaches the spy and fails. Verified GREEN in sandbox.
